subsetPolicyRationale: `s.reasoning.wires@1` is this plugin's own self-contained reasoning/wiring graph document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against. It owns no mutation: the board lives in the composed content child (s.stdio.semio@v1/graph), edited only by that child's graph leaves. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
